title: Tim Taylor shows up with experiencers Bledsoe and Charles Hall

tellings.quote: He showed up in the life of Chris Bledsoe. He showed up with Charles Hall who said that he lived with aliens at Area 51.

plain: A man named Timothy Taylor keeps turning up beside people who say they have had contact with non-human beings. Michels says this himself, without naming a source: Taylor "showed up in the life of" Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he has had such encounters, and he also turned up with Charles Hall, who says he lived with aliens at Area 51, the secret Air Force test site in Nevada. Michels raises it because a figure who keeps appearing around these witnesses might be connected to whoever is watching them.
